verdict.rationale: Datalab says Marker "handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images" and outputs Markdown/HTML/JSON (datalab-docs-52, datalab-docs-31, datalab-docs-17). A hands-on user report contradicts this: on an RPG rulebook, "many tables and text boxes were messed up", and the user fell back to screenshotting tables into ChatGPT for irregular tables (datalab-comm-3). missing for 10: documented handling of merged cells/rowspan-colspan, nested multi-level headers, cross-page table stitching, table-specific benchmarks or independent corroboration of faithful complex-table output.
